decision.trend: Research on refractory high-entropy alloys (RHEAs) has been focused on understanding their mechanical properties at elevated temperatures. Earlier studies have shown that RHEAs exhibit high yield strengths and substantial softening resistance at high temperatures. Recent studies have investigated the deformation behavior of RHEAs, including the effects of temperature, composition, and microstructure on their mechanical properties. The use of advanced characterization techniques, such as in situ neutron diffraction and transmission electron microscopy, has provided valuable insights into the deformation mechanisms of RHEAs.
